Episode 181. Meri's Dream (1)
Tikan Palace, garden terrace.
"Brother, when did we become close?"
Meri said, stirring the fruit in front of her. The ice in the spoon rattled, making a pleasant sound.
"Why are you asking that all of a sudden?"
Defus pulled out a pack of cigarettes from his pocket.
"I was just wondering, but I can't remember."
He put his fingers in and found the pack was empty.
"Ha, ran out. I'm too lazy to go get more. You don’t have cigarettes, do you?"
"No, I don’t. Can you please pay some attention to my question?"
"Well, I suppose we naturally became close at some point."
"No, I can't alleviate this frustrating feeling with such a half-hearted answer. I haven't been able to sleep for days because of it."
"Why are you so upset about it?"
"You know, once something starts to bother me, I'm always like this. I can't focus on anything else until it's resolved. Haven't you noticed?"
"You should change that attitude, kid. Sometimes, you need to just let things be. Oh, Hedo."
Hedo, passing by the table where the two were sitting, handed Defus a cigarette.
"I'll repay you with two next time."
"Of course, with the finest quality from Mila Mountain."
Defus, who happily took a drag of the cigarette, rummaged through his pocket and sighed again.
He didn’t have a lighter.
Chirp-!
"If you ever need help, you can find Jet at the entrance, Lord Defus."
This time, Jet, who was passing by, swiftly brought a match to Defus's mouth.
"Jet, very timely. I've noticed while staying here, you're always such a timely person."
"It's no wonder our Lord took Jet in. Do you two need anything else? Shall I get you some special cookies from Lady Ratri’s store?"
"Go get a hammer. If possible, one made by Lord Picon."
"Eh, Lady Meri. A hammer? Why would you need a hammer...?"
"To crack open our dear brother's head who keeps ignoring my question."
"Haha, enjoy your time. I'll take my leave now."
Huff…!
Soon, a sense of satisfaction crossed Defus's face as he exhaled a puff of smoke. Meri, with a fiery temper, glared at Defus fiercely.
"Ah, well. I got it, I got it. We just need to think back."
"Yep, think back now."
"Let's see. Here, nanny Gili! Just a moment."
Defus called out to Gili who was passing by.
"Yes, young master Defus. What is it?"
"Back when you first came to our family, was I close with this girl?"
"Hmm... To be honest, I'm not sure. I spent most of my time in the Storm City looking after young master Jin."
"Are you asking nanny Gili when I told you to think?"
"But when you and young master started living at the main house, the bond between you two seemed very strong."
"Well, since we were both squires at the time, that would make sense. Thanks for the answer. By the way, how's your injury?"
"Thanks to the care from everyone, it's getting better. And young master Defus, you can stop feeling sorry now."
"I appreciate you saying that... Then stop making our youngest upset with unnecessary work and go rest."
As Gili bowed her head and continued on her way, Meri gripped her spoon.
"Hmm, hmm! I think we first became close when you graduated from the beginner class. I helped you choose your sword then."
"You chose very carelessly. I remember your terrible advice after a long time. Hey, you use this. It's a chain sword, called Viper. Perfect for sneaky kids with dirty looks like you."
"But how long did you use that carelessly chosen weapon? Until it broke in Recalton."
"Anyway, you're wrong. I chose Viper to show you up. After beating you one on one, I wanted to say that I can beat you even with the sword you carelessly chose..."
"Unfortunately, I never heard that. From then on, you would pick fights with me but never won."
"You were already a knight then, so it's not good to boast about something that's natural. But don't you remember being scratched by Viper coated in poison and suffering for a few days?"

"You ambushed me in the bathroom during a friendly duel event? Breaking all rules. I still have the scar here. Anyway, you should be grateful to me. If I made a big deal out of it, you would have been in big trouble. Oh, so we became close because I kept my mouth shut then!"
"No. For a while after that day, you looked at me like I was a bug."
"Meri, are you saying that was human behavior?"
"It was a bit like that. After all, I did that and still lost."

"It seems we've veered off the point. Anyway, if it wasn't that... At the brothers' feast that Joshua organized, the day we glared at the bastard together and felt a sense of kinship. That's the day!"
"That day we did feel a kinship, but that was all. The same went for the long time when we both felt the wall towards sister Luna."
"That's a story that applies to all brothers."
"Except the youngest, I guess."

"The day I accidentally found you planning to blow up the eldest brother's room with a bunch of magical bombs? Or the day I stopped you from challenging our father as soon as he went to the bathroom?"

"Wrong. Was it really an accident? I feel like you were watching me as if I was a problem child. Thinking about it, there were no accidents from some point. It was all the result of you monitoring me."
"Because you did crazy things not just once or twice, so was it that day I......"
After that, Difus continued to talk about the many past events he had experienced with Mary.
No, he was happily talking about precious memories.

It had been a long time since they had such a leisurely afternoon. So joyful and comfortable, Difus didn't even realize that the cigarette he had barely sipped was almost entirely burned out between his fingers.
Mary was also laughing. Sometimes when Difus brought up an embarrassingly old story, she took a swig of her drink, but generally she laughed so hard she was close to tears.
"…hehe, haha, oh my. I'm going crazy. Yeah, there were those times too, ah! You scared me!"
"He."
"Yona! How long have you been there?"
"Since Heddo gave Difus his cigarette earlier."
"Oh my."
"Hehe, Mary and Difus, you both are so silly. Why don't you know what I know?"
"Oh, are you saying that you know when we became close? Yona."
Yona shyly smiled and pointed outside the terrace.
On the endless blue sea above, Mary's ship, Puberty, and the fleet of Cosmos were floating.
Mary and Difus seemed to realize something and exclaimed at the same time.
"Right! That was the day. The day you named my ship!"
"Yeah, that was around the time when you became a reserve rider and were leaving the family. But Yona, how do you..."
When they turned around, Yona had already disappeared somewhere.
And the two looked around for a moment, recalling the same moment.
-You're probably the only one who's going to get a ship as soon as you become a reserve rider.
-I've fought a lot on land, so I want to take a shot at the sailors too.
-When you get a ship, I think Puberty would be a good name. Please, return as an adult after going through various things on that ship.
"Alright, you should try to grow up too."

"But even if it's hard to become an adult, come back alive at least. I question whether you'll really be able to survive with that awful personality after leaving the family. It's entirely thanks to me that you've survived until now."

"Ah, it seems like the talented fourth generation wants to provoke me. Then shall we make a bet? I'll bet that I'll come back stronger than you. You can bet that I'll end up as a worm. What will you give me if I win? By the way, I can't give anything if I lose. I'll be dead."
In retrospect, that was the day.
Even though Mary responded irritably to Difus's sincere worry, that day was the first time the bond that had unknowingly built up between them was directly expressed in words.

"Just come back, and I'll protect you again from then on. Just like I've been doing, I'll watch your back if you mess up, and I'll stop you if you rush into danger without thinking... That's what my brother said to me that day."

"You sneered that it seemed like dealing with my messes had become your hobby. Well, you did show a touch of cuteness for the first time, leaving a note asking me to keep the promise. It seems like that was the first and last time."
"I was a child then, so I could have done that, but why did you? Why did you say such things to me, who was so ungrateful?"
It wasn't just words. In reality, Difus had always looked after Mary more than himself until now.
And Mary still didn't know the reason for this. Why had Difus cared for her since then?

"Do you think there's a grand reason? At first, I just felt a sense of pity, and then I found it really fun to be with you. You became something resembling a person after becoming a rider. As a brother, I felt a great sense of fulfillment."
The reason wasn't that important. They both chuckled like children.
"Are you feeling better now? Will you be able to sleep well from today?"
At Difus's following question, Mary was about to nod, but she paused in thought.
"No, there's still one more thing I want to ask you."
The smile disappeared from Mary's face.
"Why did you do that? Why...why did you betray me, the youngest, the family, the world, and accept the power of the monster...?"
Difus took the burned-out cigarette from between his fingers.

"Gillie said you don't need to feel more sorry, and the other colleagues think the same. You came to your senses in the end. But I'm not yet convinced. So tell me now. There must be a reason you had to do that, right?"
"Mary, let's go for a walk."
"Don't try to dodge the answer again. I have to hear it today. If I don't get an answer from you, I."
"Come on, I'll talk as we walk."
Suddenly, Difus got up from his seat and started to move.
Mary, stunned, watched Difus's retreating figure, then got up from her seat and followed him.
